The segment reported a net loss of EUR 2.5 million (unchanged YoY), impacted by higher fuel costs (up EUR 8.4 million vs Q2 2025), full EU ETS emissions surrender (100% of CO2 equivalent vs 70% in 2025), and the 36-month charter of the Superfast IX vessel from May 2026.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Events in Q2 2026: Maritime transport business segment (I7)

candidate_sentences.text: Tallink’s second-quarter revenue was unchanged at EUR 207.0 million, but EBITDA fell to EUR 34.3 million from EUR 37.4 million and passenger numbers declined 2.2%.
Higher fuel costs, up EUR 8.4 million year on year, the increase in EU ETS surrender requirements to 100% from 70%, weak demand and geopolitical-related energy-market volatility affected results.

verified_key_information_units.information: Elenger Grupp's Q2 2026 gas and electricity sales volumes decreased by 34% to 3.3 TWh (from 4.9 TWh in Q2 2025), primarily due to reduced wholesale sales. The segment held a 29% market share in the Finnish-Baltic gas market. During Q2, Elenger continued developing battery energy storage systems, with a 4.5 MW facility in Liepāja, Latvia entering commercial operation at the start of Q3 2026. Polish subsidiaries secured a EUR 60 million loan agreement to expand the Polish gas business.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Events in Q2 2026: Energy business segment (I7-I8)

candidate_sentences.text: Second-quarter revenue declined 12.6% to EUR 440.9 million, mainly because lower wholesale sales reduced energy volumes.
In energy, sales volumes fell 34% to 3.3 TWh as wholesale sales declined, while regional gas consumption fell 7%.

verified_key_information_units.information: INF Infra continued construction of Rail Baltica's mainline on the Kangru-Saku section (contract value EUR 67.2 million, scheduled to continue until March 2028). Construction of the Depo DIY store adjacent to the Tallink Tennis Centre progressed, with completion planned for autumn 2026. Renovation of 166 rooms at Tallink Express Hotel was completed in May 2026 following closure for renovations since November 2025.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Events in Q2 2026: Real Estate Development and Construction Projects (I8)

verified_key_information_units.information: Cash and cash equivalents increased to EUR 253.2 million as at 30 June 2026 (from EUR 146.4 million at 31 December 2025). Operating cash flow for H1 2026 was EUR 99.5 million, reflecting cash flow management and the maintenance of a liquidity buffer to finance new investments.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Key Figures for Q2 2026 (I12), Consolidated Cash Flow Statement (I19)
